title: OU football stuns No. 1 Texas with last-second Tate Sandell FG after Arch Manning INT - The Oklahoman
description: The Oklahoma Sooners stunned the top-ranked Texas Longhorns 27-24 in the Red River Rivalry thanks to a late field goal by Tate Sandell.

title: Kentucky converts 2-point play in OT to upset No. 10 LSU - ESPN
description: Quarterback Kenneth Minchey ran for a 2-point conversion in overtime to lift Kentucky to a 35-34 victory over No. 10 LSU on Saturday night.

title: Guardians complete ALDS comeback over White Sox, strike out record 21 batters to set up date with Rays - Fox News
description: Jose Ramirez's historic low home run and a record 21 strikeouts powered the Cleveland Guardians past the Chicago White Sox in ALDS Game 5.

title: UFC Vegas 122 results: Brendan Allen forces late tap, calls out former champ - MMA Junkie
description: Brendan Allen went into his bag of tricks to pull off a late submission of Christian Leroy Duncan at UFC Fight Night 290.
